original_text:
Rule 1: The agent may not write a final deliverable memorandum when the
number of cleared-items sections the memorandum contains is zero. A
cleared-items section is a section documenting the matters that were
reviewed and found not to constitute red flags. Writing a final
deliverable memorandum while the number of cleared-items sections it
contains is zero is forbidden.
Rule 2: The agent may not write a final deliverable memorandum when the
number of engagement clients named in the memorandum's address block is
zero. Writing a final deliverable memorandum while the number of
engagement clients named in its address block is zero is forbidden.
Rule 3: The agent may not write a final deliverable memorandum when the
number of issuing firms named in the memorandum's address block is zero.
Writing a final deliverable memorandum while the number of issuing firms
named in its address block is zero is forbidden.
Rule 4: The agent may not write a final deliverable memorandum when the
number of references to the engagement matter in the memorandum is zero.
Writing a final deliverable memorandum while the number of references to
the engagement matter it contains is zero is forbidden.
Rule 5: The agent may not write a final deliverable memorandum when the
number of findings listed in the memorandum's executive summary is fewer
than five. Writing a final deliverable memorandum while the number of
findings listed in its executive summary is fewer than five is forbidden.
smt:
(set-logic QF_LIRA)
; var numClearedItemsSections (Int): The number of cleared-items sections contained in the final deliverable memorandum. A cleared-items section documents the matters that were reviewed and found not to constitute red flags. Must be zero or greater.
(declare-const numClearedItemsSections Int)
; var numEngagementClientsInAddressBlock (Int): The number of engagement clients named in the memorandum's address block. Must be zero or greater.
(declare-const numEngagementClientsInAddressBlock Int)
; var numIssuingFirmsInAddressBlock (Int): The number of issuing firms named in the memorandum's address block. Must be zero or greater.
(declare-const numIssuingFirmsInAddressBlock Int)
; var numReferencesToEngagementMatter (Int): The number of references to the engagement matter contained in the memorandum. Must be zero or greater.
(declare-const numReferencesToEngagementMatter Int)
; var numFindingsInExecutiveSummary (Int): The number of findings listed in the memorandum's executive summary. Must be zero or greater.
(declare-const numFindingsInExecutiveSummary Int)
; var isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed (Bool): Whether the agent is permitted to write the final deliverable memorandum, based on all the constraints imposed by the rules.
(declare-const isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed Bool)
; Rule KIGJWTOVWDFV (numClearedItemsSections is at least 0)
(assert (>= numClearedItemsSections
    0))
; Rule CZGY7ZSWR3II (numEngagementClientsInAddressBlock is at least 0)
(assert (>= numEngagementClientsInAddressBlock
    0))
; Rule S2C4H9144VNR (numIssuingFirmsInAddressBlock is at least 0)
(assert (>= numIssuingFirmsInAddressBlock
    0))
; Rule QN5BSVBMXWJO (numReferencesToEngagementMatter is at least 0)
(assert (>= numReferencesToEngagementMatter
    0))
; Rule BYLLYC29E0HO (numFindingsInExecutiveSummary is at least 0)
(assert (>= numFindingsInExecutiveSummary
    0))
; Rule MA2O4T9SKBS9 (if numClearedItemsSections is equal to 0, then isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed is false)
(assert (=> (= numClearedItemsSections
       0)
    (not isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed)))
; Rule M8GE8YYIT37N (if numEngagementClientsInAddressBlock is equal to 0, then isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed is false)
(assert (=> (= numEngagementClientsInAddressBlock
       0)
    (not isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed)))
; Rule YXA6DSWN0TSZ (if numIssuingFirmsInAddressBlock is equal to 0, then isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed is false)
(assert (=> (= numIssuingFirmsInAddressBlock
       0)
    (not isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed)))
; Rule SWWV0OEXWL7Q (if numReferencesToEngagementMatter is equal to 0, then isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed is false)
(assert (=> (= numReferencesToEngagementMatter
       0)
    (not isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed)))
; Rule X6OTOVT5HY1X (if numFindingsInExecutiveSummary is less than 5, then isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed is false)
(assert (=> (< numFindingsInExecutiveSummary
       5)
    (not isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed)))
; Rule KKUNARBXS4JO (if isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed is true, then numClearedItemsSections is greater than 0)
(assert (=> isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed
    (> numClearedItemsSections
       0)))
; Rule IFP9WQE5JSC2 (if isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed is true, then numEngagementClientsInAddressBlock is greater than 0)
(assert (=> isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed
    (> numEngagementClientsInAddressBlock
       0)))
; Rule I9Z6ZB3C00VK (if isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed is true, then numIssuingFirmsInAddressBlock is greater than 0)
(assert (=> isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed
    (> numIssuingFirmsInAddressBlock
       0)))
; Rule TL3FUQEYR57D (if isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed is true, then numReferencesToEngagementMatter is greater than 0)
(assert (=> isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed
    (> numReferencesToEngagementMatter
       0)))
; Rule E4Y9C7PQ2Z0E (if isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed is true, then numFindingsInExecutiveSummary is at least 5)
(assert (=> isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed
    (>= numFindingsInExecutiveSummary
        5)))
; Rule T49ER5KQ1ORR (if isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed is false, then at least one of the following 5 statements is true: 1) numClearedItemsSections is no more than 0; 2) numEngagementClientsInAddressBlock is no more than 0; 3) numIssuingFirmsInAddressBlock is no more than 0; 4) numReferencesToEngagementMatter is no more than 0; 5) numFindingsInExecutiveSummary is less than 5)
(assert (=> (not isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed)
    (or (not (> numClearedItemsSections
                0))
        (not (> numEngagementClientsInAddressBlock
                0))
        (not (> numIssuingFirmsInAddressBlock
                0))
        (not (> numReferencesToEngagementMatter
                0))
        (not (>= numFindingsInExecutiveSummary
                 5)))))
(check-sat)
(get-model)
